title: RNA and Protein Extraction from Bulk Dissections
author: Miquel Vila
materials: Preheat Nuclease-free Water (#129114, Qiagen-Werfen) at 95oC (for elution).

steps.title: Prepare Reagents
steps.instruction: Prepare the necessary solutions for the extraction process.

substeps.instruction: Add 375ul of 2-mercaptoethanol to 2X Denaturing Solution.
Add 21ml of 100% Ethanol to miRNA Wash Solution 1.
Add 40ml of 100% Ethanol to Wash Solution 2/3.
Preheat 2x Denaturing Solution to 37°C until completely in solution to dissolve crystals.

steps.title: Prepare Cell Disruption Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare the disruption buffer in 2mL eppendorfs and keep on ice.

substeps.instruction: Add Protease/phosphatase inhibitor cocktail 100x (1/100) (#5872S, Werfen - Cell signaling) to Cell disruption buffer.
Dispense 500ul of Cell disruption buffer into 2mL eppendorfs (volume can range from 100 to 625ul; approximately 500ul per 50mg tissue).

steps.title: Homogenize Tissue Samples
steps.instruction: Disrupt the bulk dissections while maintaining cold temperatures.

substeps.instruction: Keep bulk dissections on dry ice until adding to the cell disruption buffer.
Add frozen bulk dissections to the 2mL eppendorfs containing the Cell disruption buffer.
Disrupt samples using an Omni Tissue Homogenizer (TH) for no more than 5s, then return to ice.
If tissue clumps remain, homogenize for an additional 5s.
Avoid taking the rotor out of the buffer to prevent foam creation.

steps.title: Split Sample for RNA and Protein
steps.instruction: Divide the homogenate into two aliquots for separate extractions.

substeps.instruction: Split the sample into 200ul for RNA and 200ul for Protein (approx. 100ul is lost as foam).
Leave the protein sample on ice for a minimum of 10 minutes.

steps.title: Extract RNA
steps.instruction: Perform RNA extraction using the split RNA sample in a fume-hood.

substeps.instruction: Add 200ul of 2x Denaturing Solution (same volume as the RNA sample split).
Add 400ul of Acid-Phenol: Chloroform (same volume as the combined sample and denaturing solution), using only the bottom phase of the bottle.
Centrifuge for 8min at max speed; centrifuge again if the interphase is not compact.
Remove the upper aqueous phase (avoiding the interphase) and transfer to a new tube.
Add 1.25x volumes of 100% Ethanol at room temperature.
Pipette up and down 3 times and transfer to a filter column (max 700ul; perform successive transfers if necessary).

steps.title: Wash and Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Wash the filter column and elute the RNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 700ul miRNA Wash Solution 1, centrifuge 15s at 10,000g, and discard flow-through.
Add 500ul Wash Solution 2/3, centrifuge 15s at 10,000g, and discard flow-through (repeat twice).
Centrifuge the column for 1min at 10,000g to eliminate residual fluid.
Transfer the column to a new collection tube.
Add 30ul Nuclease-free water pre-warmed at 95°C to elute RNA.
Re-load the eluate into the column and centrifuge again for 30s at 10,000g.
Immediately place samples on ice.

steps.title: Analyze and Store RNA
steps.instruction: Quantify the RNA and store it at ultra-low temperatures.

substeps.instruction: (Optional) Take 1.5ul for Bioanalyzer analysis.
(Optional) Take 1.5ul for RNA concentration quantification with NanoDrop ND-1000 Spectrophotometer.
Store samples at -80°C as fast as possible.

steps.title: Extract Protein
steps.instruction: Process the protein aliquot saved from the split.

substeps.instruction: Take the split protein sample and centrifuge at 4°C at 10,000g for 2min.
Collect the supernatant and transfer it to a new tube.
